LightningComponentBundle.description: Advisor briefing screen — household-aware strategy vs portfolio, tasks, events, last meeting, AI topic suggestions.

property.name: inputPrimaryMember
property.label: 1. Input: Primary Household Member
property.description: The household's primary member Account. Always pre-selected and locked.

property.name: inputHouseholdMembers
property.label: 2. Input: Household Members (Person Accounts)
property.description: All person accounts in the household. The user can toggle which to include.

property.name: inputBusinessAccounts
property.label: 3. Input: Business Accounts
property.description: Business accounts linked to the household via AccountContactRelation.

property.name: portfolioFlowApiName
property.label: 4. Data Fetch Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched flow that outputs HoldingsCollection, StrategyCollection, and StrategyProductCollection per Account (same contract as portfolioRebalancingTool2).

property.name: taskFlowApiName
property.label: 5. Tasks Subflow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched flow that accepts a 'recordIds' String collection and outputs 'outputTasks' (Task collection).

property.name: eventFlowApiName
property.label: 6. Events Subflow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched flow that accepts a 'recordIds' String collection and outputs 'outputEvents' (Event collection).

property.name: milestoneFlowApiName
property.label: 6b. Milestones Subflow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched flow that accepts a 'recordIds' String collection (household Account Ids) and outputs 'outputMilestones' (Household_Milestones__c collection).

property.name: topicSuggestionFlowApiName
property.label: 7. AI: Topic Suggestion Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched flow that returns a JSON array of {title, rationale} suggestions via output variable 'GeneratedTopics'.
